author: Cobratate
text:
Today, after 62 days in jail, a member of staff rushed up to me with forms on how to use the phone.

I've been here for over 2 months without any access to a phone call and have been ignored every time I ask, but after this tweet, they panicked and brought me phone instructions within 30 minutes.

I should have had a phone call on day one.

Imagine every man held here before me.

If I were just a normal American citizen here without a global voice, they would have ignored me forever.

Is FDC where men get thrown in holes and can’t contact their families, based on accusations from another country? Events that supposedly happened 15 years ago?

This is how FDC Miami is treating American citizens being held in prison PRE-TRIAL. UNCONVICTED.

There are thousands of men in this building who do not have a large enough Twitter account to get their rights respected.

The jail is reading every post. They are afraid. They are breaking laws daily and they know they are.

It is time for somebody senior at @OfficialFBOP to visit and audit this facility URGENTLY. 

Anyone who ignores what is happening here is culpable. 

Most of the men in here, whether innocent or guilty of alleged crimes, are UNCONVICTED.

If it is innocent until proven guilty, there are innocent Americans in these conditions.

They have reduced my food to half a tray, stone cold. They’re trying to punish me.

I would never kill myself.
